scope: Copied production web bundle; all HTTP intercepted; no host, SSH, Agent or production execution.
checked: Standard identity rejection requires explicit recovery selection and a reason; actual snapshot, IPv6 endpoint, retain policy and exact revocation scope are reviewed
Recovery mode, reason and purge choice are immutable once the plan exists
Unbound host recovery supports explicit purge; missing identity succeeds with no unrelated credential revocation and an accurate receipt
Corrupt identity and partial runtime are explicitly visible in the actual remote snapshot
Recovery remains gated by the independent server capability
Synchronous double clicks issue one preflight, one plan and one apply
A lost plan response locks creation and recovers the persisted original by check, credential, mode, reason, purge and prior IDs
GET records with another host or operation ID are rejected and cannot enable a mutation
Ambiguous apply never replays even if GET still says awaiting approval; unknown reconciliation uses the current replacement credential explicitly
Mutation responses with a different operation ID cannot replace the original persisted record
Admin downloads a SHA256-verified fixed script using Blob without enrollment token or remote execution; purge command is opt-in
